name: bank-transfer-invest-confirmation
subject: Your investment has been reserved - please make your payment
previewText: Your investment is pending and will be confirmed once you have completed your bank transfer to pay for the investment

fields.heading: Pay for your reserved investment
fields.body:
Hi {user_first_name},

Your investment has been reserved, pending receipt of your bank transfer.

To confirm your investment you must make a bank transfer of the amount required to pay for the investment using the unique payment reference provided when making your investment. Once your transfer has been processed (this can take 1-2 working days) your investment will be confirmed. If you do not use the correct reference, please contact Abundance and we can match your deposit to your pending investment.
